The lyrics of the song are based on Aim to Be a Pokémon Master. The opening animation uses footage from the third Japanese opening, OK! ===Synopsis===
 is holding a Poké Ball and tosses it towards the screen. In a stadium, a uses on . Pikachu dodges it and uses . Ash and are then seen jumping into the water. In the water, a , two , a , and a swim across the screen. Ash turns his and faces left while holding a Poké Ball.

This is followed by Ash and Pikachu running with flying in the sky. Ho-Oh disappears toward the mountain. Ash appears on screen with a stadium in the back. Clips of his Pokémon appear on the screen. A scene then follows, showing Ash, his Pokémon, , and looking at a city. The Legendary beasts and are shown on a mountaintop, and and are shown in a city at night.

Ash and the others are then shown walking in a cave where and appear. Ash and the others stood at a bridge, with several in the sky. Then, the Pichu Brothers are shown under the bridge. The screen then switches to four Baby Pokémon, , , Delia Ketchum, Officer Jenny, and Nurse Joy, with in front of them. Finally, Ash, his Pokémon, Misty, and Brock stood together.
